product_change: fix(entityos): probe X11 reachability before GUI boot

grf_collapse.observed_reality: The current EntityOS head now tests actual X11 reachability before choosing GUI boot; the previously observed stale/unreachable DISPLAY case falls back to the declared non-graphical first-start/headless path.
grf_collapse.preferred_hypothesis: The availability/precondition mismatch that caused ENTITYOS_X11_DISPLAY_OPEN_FAILED on a stale DISPLAY is repaired for the tested boundary.
grf_collapse.strongest_counterhypothesis: Other display failure windows can still exist after the reachability probe, so this does not prove complete GUI race/recovery behavior.
grf_collapse.falsifier: Disconnect or invalidate the X endpoint after a successful reachability probe but before/during visual shell creation and verify explicit fail-closed/recovery semantics.

unusual_experiment.name: ONEFILE_RELOCATED_UNICODE_TMPDIR_FOREIGN_CWD
unusual_experiment.note: The local stale-DISPLAY regression is an ordinary compatibility falsifier, not an additional unusual experiment.
